title: The Corridor of Changing Numbers

features.name: the numbered doors that shift
features.desc-on-touch: Doors labeled 1 through 6 appear and disappear as you watch. Each door opens to the same hallway photographed from six different angles, six different times. The numbering is not memory; it is cycle.

features.name: the day-counter grid
features.desc-on-touch: A matrix glowing on the corridor wall: two days rendered as identical maps, coordinates and timestamps shifting between Newcastle and desert interior. The grid cannot decide which is original.

features.name: the repeating address-sign
features.desc-on-touch: A directory listing the same address seven times, each entry leading to the same apartment at a different point in its loop. Your room number changes every time you walk the corridor, but you always arrive at the same place.

features.name: the chapter-marker beacon
features.desc-on-touch: A pulsing point of light coded to the chapters of a story—six of them, but the sixth loops back to the first. The light blinks in a rhythm that teaches you the cycle, so you can hum it even when you cannot see the source.

inscription: the corridor learned that patience means walking the same hallway seven times and never arriving at a different door; here 'return' is not a direction but an architecture
